evals.prompt: My claude-hud statusline stopped showing up after installing on a Bun-only machine. How do I diagnose and fix it?
evals.expected_outcome: Runs preflight, highlights that Node.js (not Bun alone) is required by hud.mjs, and runs hud.mjs doctor + /claude-hud:setup.
assertions: Calls out Node.js requirement over Bun alone

evals.prompt: Switch claude-hud to a compact preset and preview it before applying.
evals.expected_outcome: Uses hud.mjs schema -> hud.mjs set -> hud.mjs preview on ~/.claude/plugins/claude-hud/config.json.
assertions: Inspects schema and runs preview via hud.mjs

evals.prompt: Export a JSON breakdown of my last 30 days of Claude and Codex token costs.
assertions: Routes historical token and cost reporting to ccusage
